name: Jan Novak
bio:
Jan's journey into the world of motorsport finance started unexpectedly during his university days. Initially studying economics with a focus on international markets, he found himself drawn to the complex financial ecosystem surrounding a local racing team. He volunteered his time, quickly impressing the team's management with his keen eye for detail and ability to analyze complex financial data. This led to a full-time position after graduation, where he honed his skills and developed a deep understanding of the unique financial challenges and opportunities within the motorsport industry.

At Arrow McLaren, Jan approaches his role with a blend of meticulous precision and strategic thinking. He believes that sound financial management is not just about balancing the books but also about identifying opportunities for investment and innovation that can give the team a competitive edge. He is particularly focused on leveraging data-driven insights to optimize spending and ensure that resources are allocated effectively across all areas of the team's operations. Jan is known for his proactive approach, consistently seeking ways to improve financial processes and contribute to the team's overall success.

What sets Jan apart is his unwavering dedication to the team's goals and his ability to translate complex financial information into actionable insights for non-financial stakeholders. His loyalty and commitment make him a valued member of the Arrow McLaren team.
